full_prompt_en: A square aged storybook painting shows a small tan boat carrying several tiny people across dark water beneath a disproportionately large white bird. The surface resembles worn paper, with cracks, speckles, rubbed patches, and faded pigments throughout. Across the upper half, a muted green-gray sky holds rounded ocher and dusty pink clouds, with a pale coiled sun-like shape among them. Small birds and decorative marks dot the distance. The large white bird flies rightward across the upper middle, its open wings described by many fine parallel feather lines. A dark eye and small beak make the head distinct against the green background. Below it, delicate trees and low clustered forms fill a flat shore; several tall, narrow pink shapes rise on the left, while yellow and gray foliage gathers toward the right. The boat lies across the lower middle, with a simple flat hull and open side. A few miniature figures with dark hair and patterned clothing sit or stand aboard, and a small cabin-like frame occupies its right half. Their faces are only lightly defined, appropriate to their tiny scale. The water below is deep blue-green, nearly black at the bottom, and crossed by thin horizontal strokes. Pale little bird shapes appear near the surface. The light is even and pictorial, without cast shadows; contrast comes from the white bird and tan hull against the darker water and green surroundings. Thin drawn details remain visible within broad chalky color areas, and the worn paper merges the whole scene into one antique surface. No readable text appears. The overall composition is whimsical and quiet, suspending a small journey between an oversized flying form and a dark horizontal water band.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形陈旧绘本绘画呈现一只载着几名微小人物的浅棕色小船横过深色水面，上方飞着一只比例格外巨大的白鸟。画面像磨旧纸张，处处可见裂纹、斑点、被擦去的区域和褪色颜料。上半部低饱和绿灰天空里有圆润的赭色与灰粉云朵，其中还有一道浅色盘绕的太阳般形状。细小鸟影和装饰痕迹散布远处。巨大的白鸟从中上部向右飞，张开的翅膀由许多细密平行羽线描绘。深色眼睛和小嘴使鸟头在绿色背景前清楚可辨。它下方，纤细树木与低矮成簇形体填充平坦岸边；左侧升起几个高而窄的粉色形状，黄灰色枝叶聚向右方。船横在下部中央，船身简单平直，上方敞开。几名深发、穿图案衣服的微型人物坐或站在船上，右半部还有一个小舱架。他们的脸只作轻微定义，符合微小尺度。下方水面为深蓝绿，到最底部几乎变黑，被细薄水平笔痕划过。水面附近可见浅色小鸟形。光线均匀而图画化，没有投影；对照来自白鸟和浅棕船身与较深水面、绿色环境之间。细线细节保留在宽阔粉质色域内，磨旧纸面让整幅景象融合为一张古旧表面。没有可读文字。整体构图奇想而安静，让一段小小旅程悬在过大的飞翔形体与深色水平水带之间。
style_prompt_en: The antique storybook treatment uses muted green-gray, ocher, dusty rose, cream, and deep blue-green on a visibly worn paper surface. Chalky, irregular color fields coexist with fine drawn lines, so delicate internal patterns survive inside simplified shapes. Cracks, stains, missing pigment, and small specks soften every area and prevent clean digital edges. Scale may shift imaginatively, but the composition remains stable through broad horizontal layers and a low dark base. Pale focal forms float over denser muted surroundings; small decorative marks scatter through the open middle and upper areas. Lighting stays even and pictorial, with no hard modeled shadow. The overall effect is fragile, whimsical, and aged, as if a richly imagined scene has faded into its paper support.
style_prompt_zh: 这种古旧绘本表现把低饱和绿灰、赭色、灰粉、奶油色和深蓝绿放在明显磨旧的纸面上。粉质不规则色域与细描线并存，使简化形状内部仍留精巧图案。裂纹、污渍、缺失颜料和小斑点柔化每处区域，避免洁净数字边缘。尺度可以想象性地变化，但构图仍由宽阔水平层次和低位深色基底保持稳定。浅色焦点形体浮在密集的低饱和环境上，细小装饰痕迹散布于开阔的中上区域。光线保持均匀而图画化，没有硬性的塑形阴影。整体效果脆弱、奇想且陈旧，仿佛一幅想象丰富的场景逐渐褪入纸质载体。
theme_en: A small boat beneath a giant white bird in an aged storybook landscape
theme_zh: 陈旧绘本景观中，巨大白鸟下方的一只小船
name: Henry Darger
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
